summary: Sigma Lithium filed a Form 6-K on May 18, 2026, reporting the filing of a legal appeal against a local Brazilian court decision, with a potential US$10 million collateral only if a final negative ruling occurs after appeals. The company denounces a fake news campaign coinciding with record 1Q26 earnings, causing a 15% stock drop. This is a routine foreign issuer report on litigation and market manipulation concerns, not a special situation event. No M&A, restructuring, or activist campaign is involved. Watch for legal developments and regulatory responses from FINRA/SEC regarding the alleged misinformation campaign.
